item_short_desc: Rothco’s Pick Mattock combines durability with functionality, making it an essential tool for both gardening and outdoor adventures. Featuring a forged pick and a sturdy hardwood handle, this mattock is designed for smaller digging tasks, whether you're loosening soil in your backyard garden or tackling tough roots in the wilderness. The 17-inch length offers a comfortable grip, ensuring you have the control needed to get the job done efficiently.
description: Rothco’s Pick Mattock combines durability with functionality, making it an essential tool for both gardening and outdoor adventures.
